title: THE SILVER THREAD
author: Andries J. Greyling
rationale: Jakobus volume — SA/Border War setting. Afrikaans only for this pass. San languages excluded (Indigenous). Spanish + French deferred.

targets.name: Afrikaans
directives: Voice: the people's Afrikaans — contemporary, lived-in, how South Africans actually speak. NOT Hoog-Afrikaans, NOT Netherlands Dutch, NOT archaic Bybel-Afrikaans.
Border War / military scenes may lean period-appropriate SA Afrikaans without stiff textbook register.
Proper names, invented entities, and deliberately untranslated phrases in the source stay verbatim.
Do NOT translate into San or other Indigenous languages — excluded per TRANSLATIONS.md.
BINDING CORPUS entries in the system prompt are law — use them exactly when they match.

global_directives: REGISTER: These are novels for real readers, not textbooks or news broadcasts.
CORPUS-FIRST: Human corrections in the BINDING CORPUS block outrank all model knowledge. Never contradict them.
PRESERVE the front-matter structure of build/BOOK.md exactly.
Do NOT add translator's notes, footnotes, or bracketed glosses the English source does not contain.
Chapter titles ARE translated unless they are proper nouns.
Output one file per language at build/BOOK.<code>.md, ready for tools/render_book.sh.
